application.name: Legacy workbook demo
application.description: Demonstrates workbook row -> canonical assessment mapping: Pass with evidence, Accepted risk, and N/A. A blank workbook status cell maps to NO assessment object (not reviewed), which is distinct from an explicit not_tested.

evidence.scope: Orders and profile endpoints only, one record each; other object types untested.

claim.statement: Users cannot reach records they don't own (IDOR).

raw_result_ref.value: As account A, requested B's order id via URL swap: HTTP 404; via API: HTTP 403. Recorded in review notes p.4.

basis.rationale: Workbook row #13 'Pass'. Two-account URL-swap and API probes denied cross-account access on the tested object types.

Workbook row #24 'Accepted risk'. High-severity control; acceptance recorded with owner, reason, and review-by date exactly as the workbook Notes column requires. Counts as reviewed, never as a pass, and stays visible in counters. A Critical control could not take this status (rule R5).

acceptance.reason: Internal tool, three users, prepaid API credits capped at the provider account level; full per-provider alerting deferred until pilot.

basis.rationale: Workbook row #15 'N/A' with required reason: single-tenant deployment, one organisation only; no cross-tenant boundary exists. Reason is mandatory for N/A on Critical/High rows and maps to this rationale field.
